description: Wegkenmerk spoorovergangen met geometrie op kenmerkniveau (RWS) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.rijkswaterstaat.nl. Rail crossings: If a railway crosses the main runway at the same level, then there is a railway crossing. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Track crossing characteristic with characteristic-level geometry (RWS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include wegen, wegkenmerken. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.nl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
